1:2: “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations.
2:13: “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.
8:5: 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel
a normal shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces.
9:2: Sheol is the place of the dead.
